repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a pre-cycle wait followed by a cycle. The candidate used a phase-based if/else which only executes the cycle body on subsequent iterations, missing the required immediate execution of the cycle body after the pre-cycle actions. Evidence F2 shows the IR emitted both siren and speaker actions at t=0, while the JoI only emitted the siren action.
diagnosis.change_summary: Moved the cycle body into the phase-0 branch to execute immediately after the pre-cycle wait and siren call, and removed the separate else branch.
